title: Make the preview tag only effective within the branch
goal: Use block-level variables to generate temporary banner tags while retaining the archive tag of the edit page.
summary: Variables declared with let or const within curly braces are only available within the block. Variables with the same name can be declared in the block, and the outer variables can still be read after leaving the curly brackets.
tasks: completes pageLabels(title, preview). title is the name of the work and preview is a Boolean value. Use the existing label value as the archive label.
preview is true, declare the temporary label in the if block, add "Preview-" before the work name, and then assign it to the banner. In normal mode the banner uses archive tags.
returns "banner label/archive label" separated by a slash and a space on either side. Returns "Preview-Spring Poster / Archive-Spring Poster" when previewing "Spring Poster".

example.note: rehearsal block. After leaving the if block, the function returns the official capacity of 40 recorded in the outer variable.

hint: If the two returned labels become preview labels, check whether a new value is directly assigned to the outer label in the if. Declare the temporary value inside the block and pass it to the banner.
